SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key used for admin token and encryption. Auto-generated during install.

SIGNUPS_ALLOWED.description: Allow new user registrations. Disable after creating your account.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token to access the admin panel at /admin. Auto-generated during install.

DOMAIN.description: Public URL of your Vaultwarden instance. Used for invitation emails and deep links. Auto-configured from mDNS hostname when available.

admin-panel-info.content: Access the admin panel at `/admin` using this token.

registration-warning.content: Public registration is enabled by default. After creating your account, set **SIGNUPS_ALLOWED** to `false` in Environment Variables to prevent others from registering.

cert-info.content: Vaultwarden uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate. Your browser will show a security warning on first visit — this is expected. You can safely proceed past the warning.

BACKEND.description: Internal address of the Vaultwarden server.
